description: OpenStudio-HPXML is published by NatLabRockies. It describes a residential simulation workflow that translates HPXML building descriptions into EnergyPlus runs using OpenStudio. Its scope is generic model use; applicability and spatial or temporal resolution depend on the supplied case and inputs. Access is through the public repository and its documentation. Repository code is primarily Ruby. Software was not installed or executed. Licence: BSD-3-Clause, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge.
